notes: Base "IN1608" model (1U, 5.0 lbs, no amplifier, no IPCP control processor) — distinct from IN1608 SA (amp), IN1608 MA (70V amp), IN1608 IPCP SA/MA (built-in control processor), and the newer IN1608 xi series. Spec figures here are taken from Extron's official IN1608 Series datasheet (doc 8.0-031114-D5). AC power connector type is not explicitly named in the datasheet text (only "100-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz, internal supply"); modeled as a standard IEC C14 inlet, which is Extron's standard implementation for this switcher class/form factor — treat as medium-confidence for that one port. Two of the six 3.5mm 5-pole audio-in connectors are shared with the "Over DTP" RS-232/IR pass-through pins (they are the same physical DTP Tx pass-through jacks per the spec sheet), and the DTP output jack similarly carries embedded audio/RS-232/IR alongside video — represented here as separate logical ports since they are functionally distinct signal paths documented separately in the spec. Ethernet control RJ-45 is present on IN1608 (base), IN1608 MA, and IN1608 SA; the IPCP variants instead expose a 3-port network switch. Serial control pin-out: 1=Tx, 2=Rx, 3=Gnd. USB control port is front-panel mini-USB-B (modeled as usb-b, closest available id). Relay and Digital I/O control ports listed in the general spec table apply only to IPCP variants, not the base IN1608, and were excluded.
